items.desc: In November 2025, Mr. Poetivist - a Ghanaian poet, writer and curator - dropped by the Refuge Worldwide space unannounced, three years after having submitted a guest show remotely for the radio. We were excited for the surprise visit and to meet this talented poet, so we invited him downstairs into our production studio to record. Without even a moment to prepare, he freestyled a poem dedicated to the people of Sudan. This special moment needed to be captured and shared, so we asked friends of the station NikNak, Ivano Tetelepta, Myles Morgan and our studio technician who made the recording, …
